title: The Queen's Gambit
description: White offers the c-pawn to deflect Black's d5 pawn and dominate the center. One of the most classical and instructive openings in chess.

sections.title: The Gambit Offer
sections.content: After 1.d4 d5 2.c4, White offers a pawn. It is not a true sacrifice — if Black takes with 2...dxc4, White regains the pawn easily while gaining central control.

positions.commentary: The Queen's Gambit. White challenges d5 from the side. Black usually declines with e6 or c6, keeping a solid center.

sections.title: Queen's Gambit Declined
sections.content: With 2...e6, Black builds a solid wall. The downside is the c8 bishop is temporarily blocked. White develops naturally and aims for pressure with the minority attack or central play.

positions.commentary: A standard Queen's Gambit Declined position. White piles up on d5 and prepares to develop the bishop to g5.

exercises.title: Decline Solidly
exercises.description: Black to play. Support d5 and prepare to develop the kingside.
hints: Open a path for the f8 bishop
